hero.filename: Remains of gun battery emplacement on Upper Reservation of Fort MacArthur in San Pedro, CA.jpg
hero.caption: A gun battery emplacement, just west of Battery 241 (beneath the Korean Bell of Friendship, seen in upper left), is still recognizable more than 60 years after its removal at the former Fort MacArthur military base in San Pedro, CA. The fort's Upper Reservation is now managed by the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks as Angels Gate Park.
